name: Competitor Intel
tagline: Weekly cited report on what rival local service businesses just did
description: Aim it at your local market and it researches the service companies you are up against, then files a weekly report of the moves they made, with a citation for each claim. It stays strictly read-only: no outreach on your behalf, no posting anywhere, and no advice on what you should charge.
author: TheReal_BCM
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
